title: Nine Acts of Joining
subtitle: 马戏与杂技 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 马戏与杂技（文学艺术与体育·表演与观赏）
meta: 主题语境：马戏与杂技（文学艺术与体育·表演与观赏）　|　核心词汇：circus　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 circus 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to join ① circus she could not afford, and she said the joining was the whole of the lesson. The ② circus, meaning the show and not the tent, was nine acts long and was joined by whoever came last; circus, she said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ circus in that field had the same ring, and the ④ circus at the end, meaning the one the ringmaster kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever joined properly. Circus, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ circus was the whole of the year, meaning the noise it carried and not the show. The ⑥ circus, meaning the noise and not any of that, is the only thing in a year that everybody complains about and nobody questions; circus, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a show and a noise. She said the noise is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ circus had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the ring. The ⑧ circus of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine acts and eleven years of joining; circus, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ circus I remember is the one at the end, which was joined in 1967 and is still described as the smallest in the county. A ⑩ circus, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being joined; every circus, she said, is a noise that has agreed to look like a show. She said the noise was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 马戏团；马戏表演
B. n. 马戏（指那场演出本身，与那顶帐篷相对）
C. 固定搭配：join a circus 加入一个马戏团
D. n. 马戏团（指那片场地上每一个）
E. n. 马戏团（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 喧闹（抽象：它带来的那份嘈杂）
G. n. 那份嘈杂（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The circus, meaning the show and not the tent
circus was the whole of the year
the circus had become a number in a report
The circus of the whole thing
A circus, my grandmother said in 1972

answers.why: join a circus 意为“加入一个马戏团”，1947 年母亲被派去加入她付不起钱的那个马戏团。
circus 意为“马戏团、马戏表演”，指那场演出本身而不是那顶帐篷，共九个节目，由最后来的人加入。
circus 指那片场地上每一个马戏团，每一个都是同样的场地圈。
circus 指末尾那一个（团长留下的那一个），是唯一有人认真加入过的。
circus 意为“喧闹”，抽象指它带来的那份嘈杂，父亲说 circus 就是那一年的全部。
circus 为抽象用法，指那份嘈杂本身，是一年里人人都抱怨、却没人质疑的东西。
circus 意为“马戏团、马戏表演”，到 1962 年这个 circus 成了报告里的一个数字。
circus 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个节目和十一年的加入。
circus 意为“马戏团”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1967 年加入，至今仍被说成全县最小的。
circus 为抽象总称，祖母说一个马戏团是唯一会因为被认真加入而变好的东西。
